result.situation: This is a routine washing machine fault: it doesn't heat on 60°C cycles. The landlord approved sending an engineer but set no cost limit (event 008, approval 22). Lantern Services was assigned. The appointment record is muddled: a slot of 23/02 at 3:25pm was confirmed after the time had already passed, and a call mentions Tuesday at 1pm. On 26/02 there were still no work results. The 27/02 hold was waiting on the contractor's invoice, but the same day the contractor called asking for a callback to schedule the visit. The invoice email then arrived on 28/02.
